The Tinubu Must Go Again Movement on Saturday staged a solidarity rally in Damaturu, Yobe State, to express support for President Bola Tinubu and the All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections.
The rally, tagged “Tinubu Must Go Again, Cika Alkawari”, was coordinated by the National Coordinator of the movement, Professor Almuhajir, and the Yobe State Coordinator, Dr Mukhtar Yarima Bularafa, in collaboration with the state leadership of the APC.
The procession, which commenced at the Damaturu flyover and terminated at the Pilgrim Commission Office Complex along Potiskum Road, attracted APC stakeholders, supporters and members of the movement from different parts of the state.
The Secretary to the Yobe State Government, Dr Mohammed Goje, alongside other party stakeholders, participated in the rally, which also reaffirmed the movement’s support for the APC governorship candidate in the state, Baba Malam Wali.
Speaking during the rally, the National Coordinator, Professor Almuhajir, said the exercise was aimed at mobilising support for President Tinubu’s second-term ambition and other APC candidates in the 2027 general elections.
He commended participants for maintaining peace and order throughout the procession, describing their conduct as a demonstration of political maturity and commitment to party unity.
Almuhajir expressed confidence in continued political engagement across the state, urging supporters to sustain their mobilisation efforts ahead of the forthcoming elections.
The Yobe State Coordinator of the movement, Dr Mukhtar Yarima Bularafa, said the group remained committed to promoting President Tinubu’s Renewed Hope Agenda and strengthening grassroots support for his re-election.
He disclosed that more than 20,000 supporters attended the rally in Damaturu, commending participants for their enthusiasm and peaceful conduct.
Bularafa urged members to sustain the mobilisation drive across the state ahead of the 2027 general elections.
Participants at the rally described the turnout as a demonstration of their support for President Tinubu’s second-term ambition, expressing confidence in the APC’s electoral prospects in Yobe State in 2027.
“We came out to show that we stand with President Tinubu and the APC. We are determined to sustain our support and ensure the party receives massive votes across Yobe State in the 2027 elections,” one participant said.
Another participant said the rally had reinforced their commitment to the party, adding that members would continue grassroots mobilisation to secure support ahead of the polls.
The rally featured participants carrying banners bearing messages of support for President Tinubu and the APC as they marched through designated routes in Damaturu.
